mapper.sql: id, record_id, report_no, version, status, summary, doctor_advice, generated_at, archived_at, deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_report WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_report WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_report SET doctor_advice = #{doctorAdvice}, summary = #{summary}, status = CASE WHEN #{doctorAdvice} IS NOT NULL AND #{doctorAdvice} != '' THEN 2 ELSE status END, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE t_report r JOIN t_exam_record er ON r.record_id = er.id SET r.status = 3, r.archived_at = NOW(), r.updated_at = NOW(), r.updated_by = #{operator} WHERE er.batch_id = #{batchId} AND r.deleted = 0
